Latifa bint Mohammed: My grandmother, Sheikha Latifa bint Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, was a woman who made her mark quietly, placing people at the heart of every action. Through the stories shared within our family, I came to know her as a woman who was close to people and present in the details of their lives. She saw serving the community as a responsibility that needed no spotlight, and empowering women and families as a path toward building a stronger society. In a British document, I read how others saw her, and how her contributions extended to education, healthcare, and supporting those in need, reaffirming that true impact does not always need to announce itself; it is enough for it

Ministry of Defence Denies Reports of Attack on Al Menhad Air Base The Ministry of Defence has denied media reports claiming that Al Menhad Air Base was targeted by missiles, confirming that such reports are false. The Ministry affirmed that the Armed Forces remain on a high state of readiness to respond to any threats that may arise, in a manner that safeguards the UAE’s sovereignty, security and stability. The Ministry also urged the public to rely on official sources for information and to refrain from circulating rumours or inaccurate information. #وزارة_الدفاع #وزارة_الدفاع_الإماراتية #MOD #UAEMinistryOfDefence

RT by @UAEmediaoffice: RT by @UAEmediaoffice: With the start of the new academic year, I extend my congratulations to students, teachers, administrators, and parents, and wish them a successful year that continues to support our nation’s educational journey. Our children are our true wealth, and I encourage them to embark on the new school year with optimism, ambition, and determination, making the most of every opportunity to gain knowledge and life skills. I also encourage continued cooperation between families and schools to foster a passion for lifelong learning, equip students with the skills of the future, and reinforce a strong sense of identity and values.
